title: NSW - Upgrade the Network
current_summary: Planned maintenance by an upstream provider in NSW from 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEDT on 21 Oct 2026. Software updates will be applied to access network equipment. A brief (~15 minute) service interruption is expected around 1:00 AM AEDT within the window. Impact is limited to specific identified services. We will monitor throughout the window.

updates.content:
An upstream provider will carry out planned maintenance on access network equipment in New South Wales between 12:00 AM and 6:00 AM AEDT on 21 October 2026. During this window, some services may briefly lose connection. A single interruption of about 15 minutes is currently scheduled around 1:00 AM AEDT.

We will monitor progress and update this notice if timings change. If you need to stay connected, please consider using mobile data during the brief interruption. Thank you for your patience.
